messages:
Allan Chen: Incident Bot just posted that pagerduty webhook delivery failed for infra-oncall. I'm getting multiple suppressed pages. Anyone oncall?
Incident Bot: PagerDuty webhook failure: 502 from pd-api.redwood.com for event id ev_9a8f. Retries hit circuit breaker.
Maria Lopez: I'm oncall (pager). Confirming I didn't get a mobile push or SMS. No history in PagerDuty that shows delivered.
Jamal Reed: I saw the alert in the incident channel but the oncall push didn't go out to Maria? That sounds like webhook delivery not routing.
Allan Chen: Right — looks like our incident-bot -> PagerDuty integration returned 502s for ~2min. That triggered suppression because the integration kept re-queuing. We need to verify handoff/state.
Priya Nair: Were there any handoffs in the last 10m? Could be a rotation change that mismatched the API token.
Maria Lopez: I did a quick check — rotation shows me as primary in the console. Token last rotated 2026-02-28 per secret-manager, but the integration service config shows an older token value.
Jamal Reed: ahh mismatch. Did the oncall handoff script that runs at 00:00 UTC fail?
Allan Chen: Paging logs attached (sanitized):
```
[2026-03-15T02:17:03Z] POST /v1/events -> 502 Bad Gateway (pd-api) id=ev_9a8f
[2026-03-15T02:17:04Z] retrying (1/3)
[2026-03-15T02:17:05Z] POST /v1/events -> 502 Bad Gateway id=ev_9a8f
[2026-03-15T02:17:07Z] circuit-breaker open for key=pagerduty/infra-oncall
```
Allan Chen: Also seeing 403s in the secret fetch logs around the same time (secret-manager returned expired token).
Jamal Reed: Ok this explains suppressed deliveries — integration got a bad token so PD API returned 403/502 depending on proxy.
Maria Lopez: I couldn't trigger a manual page from PagerDuty UI because the events from incident-bot weren't creating incidents.
Priya Nair: Let's escalate manually: Jamal, can you call Maria? If PD is broken we need to get a human on it.
Jamal Reed: Calling Maria now. (phone emoji)
Maria Lopez: Got the call. I'm standing by. What's the mitigation plan?
Allan Chen: Short term: flip integration to fallback token (read-only) to get through pages; longer term: rotate secret and deploy fix to the oncall-handoff script. Steps: 1) apply fallback token to pagerduty-integration service 2) restart integration 3) confirm pages deliver 4) fix the rotation job + add alert if secret fetch fails.
Priya Nair: +1. Who has access to update the integration service? Jamal?
Jamal Reed: I can patch the deployment. Doing: kubectl set env deploy/pagerduty-integration PD_TOKEN=redwood-fallback-token-rot1 && kubectl rollout restart deploy/pagerduty-integration.
Incident Bot: Deployment pagerduty-integration updated by Jamal Reed. Rollout starting.
Allan Chen: Watching logs for delivery.
(5m pass)
Allan Chen: After restart I'm seeing successful POSTs returning 202 from pd-api. Events accepted.
PagerDuty: Event ev_9a8f accepted, incident created INC-1227.
Maria Lopez: I got push + SMS for INC-1227. Confirmed.
Priya Nair: Good. Can we confirm why secret fetch returned expired token? Who rotated it?
Allan Chen: Looks like a manual rotation happened yesterday by infra-admin for compliance but our oncall-handoff job didn't pick it up because the secret version label changed and our fetcher only reads latest by name, not by version tag.
Jamal Reed: Fixing the fetcher now to accept versioned references and adding a CI test for rotation handling. I'll put a small patch and roll it into next deploy.
Maria Lopez: Also add an alert if PagerDuty webhooks return >5% 4xx/5xx in a 1m window so we don't rely on suppressed logs.
Allan Chen: Agreed. I'll create the monitor.
Priya Nair: Postmortem notes for customer-impact: Pages were delayed for ~2 minutes during the window. No production user-facing outages recorded, but internal pages to infra oncall were missed. Impacted customers: internal SRE paging only.
Jamal Reed: Owner for follow-ups: Jamal (fix fetcher + CI test), Allan (monitor for PD error rate), Maria (verify rotation docs and runbook update), Priya (lead postmortem write-up and notify support).
Allan Chen: Action items created in tracker: RD-4672 (PD integration fallback), RD-4673 (secret fetcher fix), RD-4674 (pd error monitor), RD-4675 (runbook update).
Maria Lopez: Thanks all — marking incident resolved for now. Will reopen if we see recurrence. :white_check_mark:
Incident Bot: Incident resolved by manual mitigation. Duration 00:06:40.
Allan Chen: Wrapping up: we'll do an oncall handoff dry run tomorrow to catch rotation edge cases.
Priya Nair: Noted. Closing thread.
